command: from tools import p4_exact_pilot as p; d=p.local('build/p4/bge-onnx-v2'); m=p.load(d/'manifest.json'); assert m['status']=='PASS' and m['export_attempts']==1; [(p.bound(d/r['path'],r['sha256']),p.require((d/r['path']).stat().st_size==r['size'],'size mismatch')) for r in m['files']]; print({'files':len(m['files']),'bytes':sum(r['size'] for r in m['files']),'manifest_sha256':p.sha(d/'manifest.json')})
